a.title: Microsoft's Automatic Super Resolution is now officially out for the ROG Xbox Ally X

b.lede: Microsoft is now rolling out Automatic Super Resolution (Auto SR), an upscaling technology that competes with Nvidia's DLSS, for the Xbox Ally X, Xbox Ally X20, and select Windows Copilot Plus PCs, the company announced today.
